title: chore: Release v2.0.1 patch version
body:
Patch version bump across all monorepo packages using changesets workflow.

## Changes

- **Version**: All 18 packages updated from `2.0.0` → `2.0.1`
- **CHANGELOGs**: Updated via changesets automation
- **Release notes**: "Patch release for maintenance and stability improvements"

## Affected Packages

All packages in the fixed versioning group:
- Core: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/types`
- Runtime: `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/metadata`
- Client: `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/client-react`, `@objectstack/rest`
- Adapters: `@objectstack/hono`, `@objectstack/nextjs`, `@objectstack/nestjs`
- Plugins: `@objectstack/driver-memory`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/plugin-msw`
- Tools: `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/studio`, `@objectstack/docs`

## Publishing

Ready for `pnpm release` to publish to npm registry.
